display_long_description:
Transcend Social is a groundbreaking experience that allows you to hang out with friends in ways that have never been done before. Featuring stunning environments and cutting edge innovations, the power of the Meta Quest 3/3S are taken to new heights! 

**MAKE ANYTHING APPEAR:**

[media]

Anything you want can be made with friends just by imagining it! Wish you had an actual Christmas Tree that could brighten up the mood? Just type it in and it’s created for you! Need a Birthday Cake to celebrate with friends? Like magic it’s there! Transcend Social is an incredible leap for VR, signifying a new era where YOU determine the vibe with your friends.

**YOUTUBE IT UP:**

[media]

The versatile browser allows you to carry YouTube or the Web anywhere in this experience and watch with friends. You can carry your browser to a beach chair and watch a music video, or catch up on the latest sports highlights on big screens!

**RIDE IN STYLE:**

[media]

Walking is old news, it’s time to ride! From a sports car to a futuristic hovering chair, cruising has never been so much fun.

**PLAY AND CREATE:**

[media]

Games such as lawn darts, cairn rocks, and cyberpunk darts - there is always something to do! When you’re feeling a little more creative our versatile whiteboard can allow you to draw or write anything you wish.

**PUSH THE LIMITS:**

[media]

Our promise to you is to continue pushing the limits of what can be done in virtual reality with frequent updates, enhancements, and never before seen concepts! We truly aim to blow your mind.
